parameters.content:
## WF2 · one PDF submission
Upload TICKET-<id>.pdf from the bilingual template. The optional AFTER photo is inside the same PDF. Python extracts text and photo; no Drive image search or upload ordering is needed. A usable AFTER + BEFORE pair enables image comparison. Reports without a photo still receive written assessment and FM review. Ambiguous/unreadable photos are flagged. Explicit FM approval is still required to close the ticket.

## WF2 · one PDF submission
Upload TICKET-<id>.pdf from the bilingual template. The optional AFTER photo is inside the same PDF. Python extracts text and photo; no Drive image search or upload ordering is needed. A usable AFTER + BEFORE pair enables image comparison. Reports without a photo still receive written assessment and FM review. Ambiguous/unreadable photos are flagged. Explicit FM approval is still required to close the ticket.

## WF2 · report-first completion
Upload TICKET-<id>.pdf. An optional TICKET-<id>.jpg must arrive first to be included. A lone photo prompts a report reminder. Explicit FM approval closes the ticket; rejection requests rework. A 72-hour timeout leaves PENDING_APPROVAL and sends a renewed approval request. IFC writes use an operation key; failures retain NULL and are audited. See wf2/README.md.

parameters.query:
SELECT t.*,
 t.description AS damage_description,t.ifc_name AS object_type,t.photo_before_url AS photo_url,
 te.full_name AS technician_name,te.email AS technician_email,
 coalesce(substring(t.photo_before_url from '/d/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)'),substring(t.photo_before_url from '[?&]id=([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)')) AS before_file_id
 FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN technicians te ON te.id=t.technician_id WHERE t.id=$1 LIMIT 1;

parameters.subject: [CBM] Unmatched or ineligible completion upload
parameters.message: =Upload {{ $("Completed Upload (Drive Trigger)").first().json.name }} could not be matched to an assigned ticket in ASSIGNED, WORK_DONE or REWORK. Expected TICKET-<id>.pdf and optional TICKET-<id>.jpg. Review: {{ $("Completed Upload (Drive Trigger)").first().json.webViewLink || "no link" }}

parameters.text:
=You are the quality-verification engine of a facility-maintenance system.
Image 1 is the BEFORE photo of a reported issue: {{ $('Fetch Ticket').item.json.damage_description }} (object: {{ $('Fetch Ticket').item.json.object_type }}).
Image 2 is the AFTER photo uploaded by the technician who claims the repair is complete.

Compare the two images and respond with ONLY a minified JSON object, no markdown fences: {"repair_verified": true or false, "confidence": number between 0 and 1, "observations": one short factual sentence}.
repair_verified is true only if Image 2 plausibly shows the same object with the reported issue resolved.

parameters.query:
UPDATE tickets SET status='PENDING_APPROVAL',report_text=$2,report_file_id=$3,after_file_id=$4,
 verification=$5::jsonb,approval_id=gen_random_uuid(),ifc_new_version=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE id=$1 AND status IN ('ASSIGNED','WORK_DONE','REWORK') AND technician_id IS NOT NULL
 RETURNING id,status,approval_id;

nodes.notes: Compare only when the PDF contains a usable AFTER photo and this ticket has a BEFORE photo. Otherwise assess the report with the explicit evidence status.

parameters.text: ={{ "Carry out the persisted FM decision. Bound context: " + JSON.stringify($("Closure Context").first().json) }}

options.systemMessage:
You carry out the persisted FM decision for the bound ticket and approval identity. You cannot choose another ticket or execute free-form SQL.

APPROVED: call log_ifc_maintenance and require SUCCEEDED with a real version_file. FAILED, SKIPPED, missing GlobalId, missing version or an empty tool result BLOCK closure. After successful IFC persistence, call close_ticket and require CLOSED. Only then update_technician_stats, notify_technician and notify_fm. Never send a closure message while the IFC write or ticket closure is blocked.

REJECTED: call reopen_for_rework, then notify_technician only after committed REWORK. The rejection reason is fixed by the FM decision; never invent one. Approval timeout is not rejection.

Attempt any operation at most 3 times. Read failures, use inspect_schema only for diagnosis, and retry only when useful. IFC writes use the same operation key; do not substitute another key. After a prerequisite exhausts its attempts, stop dependent objectives and report the blockage. You cannot fix a schema by inventing tool arguments.

Both notification tools use a guarded helper. It checks current database state, claims the recipient-specific notice for this approval, sends through Gmail, and records the actual Gmail message ID automatically. SENT or already_sent=true confirms provider acceptance, not that a person has read the message. UNCONFIRMED means a send was attempted without a conclusive receipt: do not resend blindly; use check_notice and request reconciliation. BLOCKED is not a successful notification. An empty tool result is not success. Do not call record_attempt to claim an email was sent: that tool records diagnostics only and cannot produce notification receipts.

Finish with a short summary of each objective, attempts and unresolved errors. The final database check independently verifies the current decision, final ticket state, successful IFC result, technician statistics and every required notification receipt. Your summary alone cannot settle the workflow.

parameters.query:
SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable
  FROM information_schema.columns
 WHERE table_schema = 'public'
   AND table_name IN ('tickets','technicians','ticket_events')
 ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position;
parameters.toolDescription: Read-only. Returns the columns and types that actually exist on the tickets, technicians and ticket_events tables. Call this when a tool error names a missing column, an unknown relation or a type mismatch, then retry the failed operation with corrected arguments. Cannot modify anything.

parameters.name: log_ifc_maintenance
parameters.description: Write the approved IFC maintenance operation and persist the actual service result. Require SUCCEEDED with a version before closure. Failure, skip or missing element blocks closure. Retries use the same operation key.

parameters.toolDescription: Close only with current FM approval and a persisted successful IFC result matching the model version. Returns BLOCKED if any prerequisite is missing. CLOSED is idempotent.

parameters.query: WITH v AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) UPDATE tickets SET status='REWORK',closed_at=NULL,fm_reject_reason=v.p->>'rejectionReason',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM v WHERE tickets.id=(v.p->>'ticketId')::int AND tickets.status='PENDING_APPROVAL' AND tickets.approval_id=(v.p->>'approvalId')::uuid AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ticket_events e WHERE e.ticket_id=tickets.id AND e.event='CBM_WF2_APPROVAL' AND e.payload->>'approval_id'=v.p->>'approvalId' AND e.payload->>'decision'='REJECTED') RETURNING tickets.id,tickets.status;
parameters.toolDescription: Reopen the bound ticket for rework after a rejected approval, recording the facility manager's reason. Idempotent: a ticket already in REWORK reports zero rows changed.

parameters.query:
WITH receipt AS (
 INSERT INTO ticket_events(ticket_id,event,payload) SELECT id,'CBM_WF2_STATS',jsonb_build_object('approval_id',approval_id)
 FROM tickets WHERE id=($1::jsonb->>'ticketId')::int AND status='CLOSED' AND approval_id=($1::jsonb->>'approvalId')::uuid
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING ticket_id)
 UPDATE technicians SET jobs_completed=jobs_completed+1 WHERE id IN (SELECT technician_id FROM tickets WHERE id IN (SELECT ticket_id FROM receipt)) RETURNING id,jobs_completed;
parameters.toolDescription: Increment the assigned technician's completed-jobs counter. Call once, after close_ticket succeeds. Reports zero rows changed if the ticket has no assigned technician.

parameters.query:
SELECT event,payload->>'notice_key' AS notice_key,payload->>'outcome' AS outcome,
 payload->>'message_id' AS message_id,payload->>'recipient' AS recipient,payload->>'error' AS error,created_at
 FROM ticket_events WHERE ticket_id=($1::jsonb->>'ticketId')::int
 AND payload->>'approval_id'=$1::jsonb->>'approvalId'
 AND event IN ('CBM_WF2_NOTICE','CBM_WF2_NOTICE_CLAIM','CBM_WF2_NOTICE_FAILED','CBM_WF2_FM_NOTICE_CLAIM') ORDER BY id;
parameters.toolDescription: Read current-approval send claims, Gmail receipts and failures. A claim without a successful receipt is UNCONFIRMED and must not be blindly resent.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ticket_events(ticket_id,event,payload)
 SELECT ($1::jsonb->>'ticketId')::int,'CBM_WF2_ATTEMPT',
 jsonb_build_object('approval_id',$1::jsonb->>'approvalId','operation_key',$1::jsonb->>'operationKey',
 'operation',$1::jsonb->>'operation','outcome',$1::jsonb->>'outcome','detail',$1::jsonb->>'detail') RETURNING id,event;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [JSON.stringify({ticketId:$("Closure Context").first().json.ticketId,approvalId:$("Closure Context").first().json.approvalId,operationKey:$("Closure Context").first().json.operationKey,operation:$fromAI("operation","Failed tool or objective","string"),outcome:$fromAI("outcome","FAILED or BLOCKED","string"),detail:$fromAI("detail","Observed error or reason","string")})] }}

parameters.toolDescription: Record a diagnostic operation attempt for the bound approval. This cannot create an email send receipt or authorize closure.

parameters.name: notify_technician
parameters.description: Send the technician notice through the guarded helper. It checks committed state, prevents duplicate attempts and records Gmail message IDs. SENT confirms provider acceptance; UNCONFIRMED requires reconciliation.

parameters.name: notify_fm
parameters.description: Send the fm notice through the guarded helper. It checks committed state, prevents duplicate attempts and records Gmail message IDs. SENT confirms provider acceptance; UNCONFIRMED requires reconciliation.

parameters.subject: =[CBM] Ticket {{ $("Closure Context").first().json.ticketId }} - closure objectives incomplete
parameters.message: =Ticket {{ $("Closure Context").first().json.ticketId }}: decision {{ $("Closure Context").first().json.decision }}, state {{ $json.status }}. Missing objectives: {{ JSON.stringify($json.missing_operations) }}. Inspect the current approval’s IFC and notification events. A sent email requires a Gmail receipt; resolve uncertain sends before retrying.

parameters.content:
## One FM decision, email or chat
A normal email links to the existing shared approval form. Its guarded helper records and executes the decision.
WF2 checks PostgreSQL every minute. Already settled: finish. Shared action still running: wait. Recorded incomplete result: Closure Supervisor finishes missing work.
After 10 minutes without an action result, report attention instead of running a competing closure. Approval replacement ends this review.
